notes.title: Alpaca Ball Easter Update!
notes.notes:
Hey!

Just in time for Easter celebrations, I am back with two cool new additions to our Alpaca Ball roster.

Enjoy your matches over the holidays with two Easter themed Alpacas.

- Mat

notes.title: The Chaos Update!
notes.notes:
Hey!

I am here today to tell you about the newest update releasing for Alpaca Ball: Allstars... THE CHAOS UPDATE!

In the past, we experimented a lot with different dynamic pitches to create completely new situations to add variance to your Alpaca Ball matches. With the Chaos Update we crank that up to 11!

The Chaos Update adds 2 new maps, the Rumble Arena and the Rumble Stadium!
In these two maps, dynamic object setups will be randomly chosen from over 20 different setups!

Check out the newest short trailer, to get a quick look at what's possible:

Of course an update from us wouldn't be complete without a few new Alpacas to choose from. The update also adds 2 new Alpaca Players, ready to rumble!

That's it! Get into your jersey and start the rumbling!

- Mathias

notes.title: The Holiday Update brings you new Alpacas and Pitches!
notes.notes:
Happy Holidays!

I am excited to bring you some new alpaca content just in time for the holidays!

The Holiday Update features the first big city pitch in the game, and it's a Christmas market nonetheless!
The Christmas Market pitch is also the first one to feature dynamic elements! It sure can be a train wreck. ːsteammockingː

Come by, drink some hot punch, eat sweets and score some goals with the three new alpaca characters that've been added!

I hope you have a wonderful time over the holidays to close out this bumpy year.

- Mat
